description:
THE LONG BEACH CRUISER XL 750W
Beach cruisers today are exploding in popularity. However, interestingly enough, they have been around for about 100 years! These days, with the rise in popularity with electric bicycles, electric beach cruisers are popular as well. Beach cruisers are commonly known as having "balloon tires", however, it is not so common to see cruisers with 4" fat tires. That is exactly what we did - with that being said we'd like to introduce the all new 2023 Long Beach Cruiser XXL 750. This e-bike is essentially a fusion of the Big Cat® Long Beach Cruiser 750 & The Big Cat ® Fat Cat XL. So what you get is a step-through-frame-style beach cruiser, with a 750w geared rear hub motor, a 48V 13Ah lithium ion battery, and 4" balloon tires. The Long Beach Cruiser XL 750 is capable of reaching speeds of up to 20mph and has an average range of 30-60 miles on a single charge. This e-bike also comes equipped with the King Meter KM-529 LCD display. This display allows riders to choose between 1-5 different levels of pedal assist, as well as receive speed, distance, time and battery life readings. The 4" tires allow you to take this electric bike on almost any terrain, and with the 750w motor, you'll be sure to have enough torque to make it through with ease. Stopping power is equally as important so we have equipped this bicycle with 203mm mechanical disc brakes.
